en: Sepia-toned street scene in an old Chinese commercial district. Narrow stone-paved lane lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings, with many vertical shop signs bearing Chinese characters hanging over the sidewalk. People in traditional Chinese clothing and straw hats, along with some in early 20th‑century Western-style shirts and trousers, walk or stand along the street. A shirtless man stands in the doorway of a wooden-fronted shop on the right; a child in checkered pants looks toward the camera. The architecture and signage suggest a treaty‑port or colonial-era Chinese city.
